key.name: name-source
key.description: Where the name shown in the Quick Settings header comes from: the account's full name, the login name, the computer's host name, or a custom name.

key.name: theme
key.description: Material You tonal palette used by the Quick Settings panel.

key.name: custom-name
key.description: Name shown in the Quick Settings header when the name source is "custom".

key.name: show-dock
key.summary: Show the dock and app menu
key.description: Show the floating Material 3 dock at the bottom of the screen, together with the app menu it opens.

key.name: ui-scale
key.description: Scale factor for the size of the whole Quick Settings panel (tiles, sliders, spacing and icons).

key.name: font-scale
key.description: Extra scale factor for the text size, applied on top of the UI scale.

key.name: font-family
key.description: Font family used for the text of the Quick Settings panel. Empty keeps the default (Plus Jakarta Sans).

key.name: theme-shell
key.summary: Color the shell with the theme
key.description: In dark mode, give the top bar, popup menus and notifications the same accent-tinted dark colors as Quick Settings.

key.name: theme-apps
key.summary: Color GTK apps with the theme
key.description: Write the accent-tinted colors to ~/.config/gtk-4.0 and gtk-3.0 (a material3-colors.css imported from gtk.css) so GTK 3 and 4 / libadwaita apps follow the theme. Apps pick it up when they are started.

key.name: show-recent
key.description: Show the "continue last" card at the bottom of the app menu, which reopens the most recently used window.

key.name: dock-mode
key.description: "static" keeps the dock visible and reserves its space, so maximized windows stop above it. "autohide" slides the dock away until the pointer touches the bottom edge.

key.name: dock-scale
key.description: Scale factor for the size of the dock (buttons, icons, spacing and text).

key.name: dock-margin
key.summary: Dock height above the screen edge
key.description: Gap in pixels between the bottom of the dock and the bottom edge of the screen.

key.name: dock-end-button
key.description: Button at the end of the dock: none, theme (palette switch) or settings (open the extension settings).

key.name: appmenu-sort
key.description: Order of the apps in the app menu: name, name-desc or usage.

key.name: preview-scale
key.description: Scale factor for the window previews shown when hovering a dock icon.

key.name: appmenu-scale
key.description: Scale factor for the size of the app menu (and the context menus).

key.name: show-quicksettings
key.description: Replace the shell's Quick Settings panel. Off restores GNOME's own.

key.name: qs-tile-style
key.description: classic: one tile, click toggles and right-click opens options. split: the icon toggles, the text area opens the options.

key.name: qs-slider-style
key.description: classic: capsule with minus and plus buttons. handle: thick track split by a handle, with round buttons after it.

key.name: qs-media-style
key.description: classic: compact card. cover: album art fills the card with a seek bar.

key.name: show-appmenu
key.description: Open the Material 3 app menu from the dock and the Super key. Off uses GNOME's Overview.

key.name: show-settings
key.description: Open the Material 3 Settings window instead of GNOME Settings from the dock, app menu and Quick Settings.

key.name: settings-search-hidden
key.summary: Settings search result hidden by this extension
key.description: Internal: true when this extension added GNOME Settings to the disabled search providers.

key.name: border-qs-width
key.description: Border width in pixels, 0 for none.

key.name: border-qs-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels.

key.name: border-qs-color
key.description: Which palette color the border uses.

key.name: border-appmenu-width
key.description: Border width in pixels, 0 for none.

key.name: border-appmenu-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels.

key.name: border-appmenu-color
key.description: Which palette color the border uses.

key.name: border-dock-width
key.description: Border width in pixels, 0 for none.

key.name: border-dock-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels.

key.name: border-dock-color
key.description: Which palette color the border uses.

key.name: border-ctx-width
key.description: Border width in pixels, 0 for none.

key.name: border-ctx-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels.

key.name: border-ctx-color
key.description: Which palette color the border uses.

key.name: border-settings-width
key.description: Border width in pixels, 0 for none.

key.name: border-settings-radius
key.description: Corner radius in pixels.

key.name: border-settings-color
key.description: Which palette color the border uses.

key.name: settings-sidebar-style
key.description: cards: grouped cards with colored icon badges and a description line. pills: compact rounded rows.

key.name: settings-sidebar-mode
key.description: Last sidebar size of the Settings app: 0 icons only, 1 medium, 2 full.

key.name: anim-scale
key.description: Speed of shell animations: 0 turns animations off, 1 is normal, 2 is twice as fast.

key.name: appmenu-width
key.description: Width in pixels of the app menu. The app cards share the width evenly.

key.name: context-font-family
key.description: Font family of the right-click menus (dock icons and app menu). Empty uses the text font of the rest of the interface.

key.name: datemenu-scale
key.description: Scale factor for the size of the date menu panel.

key.name: datemenu-font-scale
key.description: Scale factor for the text in the date menu.

key.name: context-scale
key.description: Scale factor for the size of the right-click menus, on top of the app menu size.

key.name: context-font-scale
key.description: Scale factor for the text in the right-click menus.

key.name: context-show-icons
key.description: Show an icon before each entry of the right-click menus.

key.name: appmenu-height
key.description: Height in pixels of the scrolling app grid inside the app menu.

key.name: favorite-category-enabled
key.description: When on, the app menu opens on the favorite category and reads only its apps; the other categories are read the first time they are selected. This keeps the first open of the app menu light.

key.name: favorite-category
key.description: Id of the category the app menu opens on when the favorite category mode is on.

key.name: custom-categories
key.description: JSON list of user-defined categories: [{"id": "...", "label": "...", "apps": ["app.desktop"]}].

key.name: category-order
key.summary: Order of the app menu categories
key.description: Category ids (built-in and custom) in the order their pills appear. Missing ids follow in their default order.

key.name: hidden-categories
key.description: Ids of the categories that are not shown as pills in the app menu.

key.name: show-datemenu
key.description: Replaces the content of the clock menu in the top bar with notifications, calendar, reminders, world clocks and weather in the Material 3 layout.

key.name: datemenu-notes
key.description: Reminders added in the date menu, as JSON keyed by date.

key.name: show-switcher
key.description: Replaces the shell's Alt+Tab switcher with a Material 3 window picker.

key.name: osd-enabled
key.description: Replaces the shell's on-screen display for volume, brightness and microphone with a Material 3 pill.
